curation.notes: High-resolution optical tweezers with simultaneous single-molecule FRET used to mechanically unwrap single nucleosomes assembled on fluorescently labelled 601 nucleosome positioning sequences, assigning the low-force transition to ~27 bp of outer-wrap release on one side and the high-force transition to ~76 bp released simultaneously from both sides, and following hexasome and tetrasome unwrapping/rewrapping. Only a brief Materials and Methods excerpt is available, so most instrument parameters are not stated; the force geometry in the auto record is not supported by the provided text.

entities.name: Nucleosome on 601 nucleosome positioning sequence (Cy3/Cy5 labelled DNA)

evidence.snippet: ED1, INT, and ED2 fluorescent DNA templates were generated by PCR. The primers used are based on published work (22), and Cy3-NHS and Cy5-NHS (Lumiprobe) were conjugated to the forward and reverse primers, respectively. Labeled primers were used to amplify the 601 NPS from the PGEM 601 vector.

entities.name: Histones H2A, H2B, H3 and H4 (X. laevis, human and yeast)

evidence.snippet: Recombinant X. laevis, human, and yeast histones H2A, H2B, H3, and H4 were expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) and purified from inclusion bodies as previously described (57).
Recombinant His-tagged sortase 5M in the pET30b vector was purified as previously described with some modifications (58).

applies_to.transition: low-force transition: undoing of the outer wrap of one side

source.snippet: we show that the low-force transition corresponds to the undoing of the outer wrap of one side of the nucleosome (∼27 bp), a process that can occur either cooperatively or noncooperatively

applies_to.transition: high-force transition: simultaneous unwrapping from both sides

source.snippet: whereas the high-force transition corresponds to the simultaneous unwrapping of ∼76 bp from both sides
